entities.name: Agent Tesla
entities.gloss: A .NET-based infostealer, keylogger, and remote access trojan used to harvest credentials and system information.

entities.name: RegAsm.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Microsoft .NET Assembly Registration utility often abused by malware to execute code.

entities.name: AvqOUjZwpiXQ.exe
entities.gloss: A randomly named executable file dropped and executed by Agent Tesla during installation.

entities.name: DynDns.com
entities.gloss: A dynamic DNS service provider utilized for dynamic domain resolution.

entities.name: BaDpDF.com
entities.gloss: A malicious domain name associated with Agent Tesla command and control communications.

entities.name: cm.islamabad@chinagrill.co
entities.gloss: An email address used by Agent Tesla to exfiltrate stolen credentials via SMTP.
